acceptance_evidence.authority_statement: Accepted review evidence only; no migration or live authority is created.

scope: A new, pure, isolated comparison boundary for synthetic H1R-05A snapshot fixtures. It creates neither migration evidence nor migration readiness, and performs no Go/No-Go, activation, registration, provider, network, filesystem, private-data, deletion, deployment, backup, restore, rollback, or other external action.

writer_packet.review: fresh independent Sol deep review required before acceptance

required_import_surface: exact built-in H1R-05A KnowledgeMigrationSnapshot and KnowledgeHeadMetadata types
the H1R-05B detached metadata-reference projection function used solely to validate each detached clone
forbidden_imports_or_references: MigrationProof or any legacy migration-proof class, function, constant, test helper, or result
Go, Go/No-Go, status, activation, registration, readiness, or action-authority APIs
backup, restore, rollback, evidence, receipt, or proof APIs
database, filesystem, network, provider, clock, randomness, payload, or private-data APIs
isolation.static_rule: The new module and its tests must not import, name, inspect, monkeypatch, or otherwise reference the legacy import_export_migration_proof module or any forbidden API family. The comparison module is a standalone pure boundary, not a wrapper or compatibility layer.

public_api.failure_contract: Every rejected public input, hostile slot access, projection rejection, comparison failure, or unexpected internal exception yields only the bounded, context-free invalid_comparison error. It exposes no snapshot field, digest, owner, payload, exception text, path, provider, or migration context.

validation_and_detachment: Accept only exact built-in H1R-05A KnowledgeMigrationSnapshot values; reject subclasses and all foreign look-alikes.

Read each public input and every accepted slot exactly once, validate exact scalar and tuple types, and construct an independent built-in clone of each snapshot and head before retaining or comparing anything.
Clone source, target, and post completely before invoking the H1R-05B projection on any of them. The implementation retains only its detached clones and locally constructed output tuples.
Each clone must pass the pinned H1R-05B metadata-reference projection. The three accepted clones must have the same H1R-05A schema identifier and owner_ref_digest.

Preserve and enforce the inherited snapshot constraints, including SHA-256 digest grammar, unique lexical knowledge_id_digest order, exact immutable heads, and at most 10000 heads per snapshot. Bounded local counters and byte accounting must fail before unbounded work.
Projection validates the exported snapshot envelope; it does not authenticate origin. Self-consistent synthetic fixtures remain synthetic fixture evidence only.

comparison_semantics.identity_and_change_key: Compare records only by the pair of exported fields knowledge_id_digest and record_digest. Do not compare revision, generation, state, kind, payload_sha256, inner metadata digests, projection output fields, object identity, or any legacy migration field.

delta_rules.changed_knowledge_ids: knowledge_id_digest present on both sides with unequal record_digest

comparison_semantics.ordering: Every delta field is a tuple sorted in lexical ascending order. Empty snapshots and empty tuples are valid.

result_model.delta: frozen, slots-only, redacted HarbourSnapshotDelta(label in {'source_to_target','target_to_post'}, missing_knowledge_ids: tuple[str, ...], extra_knowledge_ids: tuple[str, ...], changed_knowledge_ids: tuple[str, ...])
result_model.comparison: frozen, slots-only, redacted HarbourSnapshotComparison(schema_id, owner_ref_digest, source_snapshot_digest, target_snapshot_digest, post_snapshot_digest, source_to_target, target_to_post)
result_model.redaction: repr and error rendering are fixed content-free labels; output construction retains no caller aliases and does not reveal private data or migration state.

acceptance: Synthetic literal golden vectors cover equal, empty, changed, missing, extra, and mixed two-delta comparisons, with lexical tuple order.

Synthetic hostile fixtures cover subclasses, foreign types, bool/integer confusion, missing or throwing slots, malformed digests, duplicate or disordered knowledge ids, mismatched schema or owner, over-10000 heads, mutation after entry, and retained-alias attempts.
Tests prove all three clones are created before the first H1R-05B projection and prove a projection failure is reported as invalid_comparison without raw context.

Static tests prove the two new files contain no import or reference to src/import_export_migration_proof.py, MigrationProof, manifest, Go/status/readiness, backup/restore/rollback/evidence, or I/O/provider/network/private-data interfaces.
Focused tests run only against tests/test_harbour_snapshot_comparison.py with --noconftest; pinned H1R-05A and H1R-05B regression suites are run separately with --noconftest.

A fresh independent Sol deep review is required; it must re-check isolation, exact-type detachment, clone-before-projection sequencing, the two-field comparison key, bounds, redaction, and synthetic-fixture-only non-claims.
non_claims: No migration, manifest, readiness, status, Go/No-Go, activation, registration, or authority decision is created.
No origin authenticity, freshness, live state, payload equivalence, record recovery, backup, restore, rollback, deletion, or operational evidence is established.
No change to existing source, legacy proof code, H1R-05A store behavior, H1R-05B projection behavior, routing, registry, or deployment is authorized.
